author: pirat_nation
text:
Rockstar could take down GTA 6 spoiler videos even after launch.

The rules apply to all Rockstar games and include:

- Videos showing the ending or major plot twists.
- Standalone cutscenes and cinematic sequences.
- Edited videos combining cutscenes and story dialogue.
- Leaked pre-release footage and early unboxing videos.

Longer, narrated Let’s Plays can still include cutscenes, but standalone cinematic uploads can be removed.

These aren’t new GTA 6-specific rules. Rockstar’s general copyright policy was last updated in January 2025
